facts.fact: This document is the text of Ordonnance No. 2011-22 of 23 February 2011 on the Charter of access to public information and administrative documents, an ordinance executed as a law of the State that gives any person a right to ask public bodies for information, entering into force six months after its publication.

note: The media regulator ONC suspends nine French outlets; it states nothing about an access to information law, its rules or its application.
The ordinance creates the media regulator ONC (press, broadcasting, equitable access to public media); it is not an access to information law and names no information commission under one.

facts.fact: Niger's Minister of Communication, speaking on 22 October 2025, cited ordinance no. 2011-22 of 23 February 2011 on the charter of access to public information and administrative documents as an existing initiative to give journalists, researchers, students and citizens reliable information; the date given is the ordinance's, 2011.

facts.fact: ANLC/TI-Niger says Ordinance no. 2011-22 of 26 February 2011, the charter on access to public information and administrative documents, was adopted nearly fifteen years ago and its implementation is limited.

facts.fact: ANLC/TI-Niger says the implementing decree of the 2011 access to information ordinance has still not been adopted.
